records.jp: 世界中に灰が降った……。<CR>あたしたちがここにいることに関係するのかな？
records.en_original: Ash falling all over the world... Does that have something to do with why we're here?
records.en_auxiliary: Ash falling all over the world... Does that have something to do with why we're here?
records.en: Ash fell all over the world...<CR>Could that be connected to why we're here?

records.jp: 意味はありそうだけど……
records.en_original: I would imagine, but...
records.en_auxiliary: I would imagine, but...
records.en: There does seem to be a connection, but...

records.jp: もしかして、ココロトープで降ってる<CR>キラキラしたものも灰なのかな？
records.en_original: Maybe the shiny stuff that falls in the Heartscape is Ash too?
records.en_auxiliary: Maybe the shiny stuff that falls in the Heartscape is Ash too?
records.en: Could the glittering stuff falling<CR>in the Heartscapes be Ash too?

records.jp: でも、全然積もっている様子はありませんでした
records.en_original: But that doesn't seem to pile up at all...
records.en_auxiliary: But that doesn't seem to pile up at all...
records.en: But it didn't look like it was accumulating at all.

records.jp: わたしたちの記憶から再現されているだけで、<CR>本物の灰とは違うのかも
records.en_original: It might just be a recreation from our memories, not actual Ash.
records.en_auxiliary: It might just be a recreation from our memories, not actual Ash.
records.en: It may only be a recreation from our memories,<CR>not the real Ash.

records.jp: たしかに。<CR>その証拠に、学校では降っていないし
records.en_original: Right. The fact that it doesn't fall at school is proof of that.
records.en_auxiliary: Right. The fact that it doesn't fall at school is proof of that.
records.en: True.<CR>It doesn't fall at the school, which supports that.

records.jp: う～ん……
records.en_original: Hmm...
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm...
records.en: Hmm...

records.jp: ――コールドスリープ説を提唱する
records.en_original: I posit the theory of cryostasis!
records.en_auxiliary: I posit the theory of cryostasis!
records.en: —I propose the cryostasis theory.

records.en_original: ...What?
records.en_auxiliary: ...What?
records.en: ...What?

records.jp: だからさ、コールドスリープだよ！
records.en_original: Cryostasis! You know, suspended animation!
records.en_auxiliary: Cryostasis! You know, suspended animation!
records.en: I'm talking about cryostasis!

records.jp: 世界に灰が降って、みんな病気になっちゃうかも！<CR>って状況だったんでしょ？
records.en_original: It was raining Ash and people were getting sick, right?
records.en_auxiliary: It was raining Ash and people were getting sick, right?
records.en: The world was covered in Ash, and everyone might get sick!<CR>That was the situation, right?

records.jp: このままじゃ人類が滅んじゃう……<CR>だから、あたしたちはコールドスリープされたんだよ！
records.en_original: The population would eventually go extinct, so we were put into cryostasis!
records.en_auxiliary: The population would eventually go extinct, so we were put into cryostasis!
records.en: Humanity would go extinct at this rate...<CR>So we were placed in cryostasis!

records.jp: それで何十年……下手したら百年以上、<CR>冷凍睡眠状態になって――
records.en_original: So we were asleep for decades...or even centuries...?
records.en_auxiliary: So we were asleep for decades...or even centuries...?
records.en: Then for decades...maybe even over a century,<CR>we remained in cryogenic sleep—

records.jp: 目覚めたのが今、ってことを言いたいの？
records.en_original: And we're just now waking up. That's what you're saying?
records.en_auxiliary: And we're just now waking up. That's what you're saying?
records.en: And we're just now waking up. That's what you're saying?

records.jp: そういうこと！
records.en_original: Exactly!
records.en_auxiliary: Exactly!
records.en: Exactly!

records.jp: 灰がやむまでの間をやりすごすための<CR>コールドスリープ、ってことかぁ……
records.en_original: So we were put into cryostasis until the Ash stopped falling...
records.en_auxiliary: So we were put into cryostasis until the Ash stopped falling...
records.en: Cryostasis to wait out the period<CR>until the Ash stopped falling...

records.jp: わたしたちの記憶にある時期から、<CR>膨大な時間が経っている……？
records.en_original: Just how much time has passed since the time from our memories...?
records.en_auxiliary: Just how much time has passed since the time from our memories...?
records.en: An enormous amount of time has passed<CR>since the period we remember...?

records.jp: それに、ココロトープも簡単に言うと<CR>記憶の保存場所なわけでしょ？
records.en_original: So then that would make the Heartscape the place our memories were stored.
records.en_auxiliary: So then that would make the Heartscape the place our memories were stored.
records.en: And, put simply, Heartscapes<CR>are places where memories are stored, right?

records.jp: あれも、長い間眠って失われた記憶を<CR>取り戻すための場所だと考えるとさ……
records.en_original: Being asleep for so long made us lose our memory, but the Heartscape can help us get them back.
records.en_auxiliary: Being asleep for so long made us lose our memory, but the Heartscape can help us get them back.
records.en: If they're places for recovering memories<CR>lost during a long sleep...

records.jp: なくはない、かもしれませんね
records.en_original: I suppose it could be possible.
records.en_auxiliary: I suppose it could be possible.
records.en: I suppose it could be possible.

records.jp: すごいよ、愛央ちゃん！　名探偵だよ！
records.en_original: Wow, Ao! You're a real Sherlock Holmes!
records.en_auxiliary: Wow, Ao! You're a real Sherlock Holmes!
records.en: Amazing, Ao-chan! You're a master detective!

records.jp: え～？　えへへ、そうかな～？<CR>名探偵、なっちゃったかな～！
records.en_original: Aw, stop... You really think so? Maybe I should start my own agency!
records.en_auxiliary: Aw, stop... You really think so? Maybe I should start my own agency!
records.en: Really? Hehe, you think so?<CR>Maybe I have become a master detective!

records.jp: さ、さすがに突飛すぎるでしょ。<CR>映画じゃないんだから……
records.en_original: Let's not get carried away. This isn't a movie.
records.en_auxiliary: Let's not get carried away. This isn't a movie.
records.en: Th-that's far too outlandish.<CR>This isn't a movie...

records.jp: えー！？　でもさ、その方が面白いじゃん！<CR>映画の主役、なりたくない！？
records.en_original: Aw, come on! That'd be so cool! We'd be the main characters!
records.en_auxiliary: Aw, come on! That'd be so cool! We'd be the main characters!
records.en: What?! But that would be more exciting!<CR>Wouldn't you like to be the star of a movie?!

records.jp: 実は私たちって、人類を救うために<CR>選び抜かれた女の子たちなのかも！？　ってさ！
records.en_original: Like, what if we were actually the Chosen Ones?! A group of girls destined to save all of humanity!
records.en_auxiliary: Like, what if we were actually the Chosen Ones?! A group of girls destined to save all of humanity!
records.en: Maybe we are girls chosen<CR>to save humanity!

records.jp: ……星崎さん、そういうとこあるよね
records.en_original: Classic Hoshizaki.
records.en_auxiliary: Classic Hoshizaki.
records.en: ...Hoshizaki-san, you do have a tendency like that.

records.jp: 目立ちたい願望的なね～
records.en_original: Always wanting to stand out!
records.en_auxiliary: Always wanting to stand out!
records.en: That desire to stand out, you know?

records.jp: ……ちょ、やめてよ。<CR>急激にハズくなってきたんだけど
records.en_original: H-hey... Now I'm embarrassed of myself...
records.en_auxiliary: H-hey... Now I'm embarrassed of myself...
records.en: H-hey, stop.<CR>I'm suddenly really embarrassed...

records.jp: いろいろ考えられるようにはなって来たけど、<CR>まだ情報が足りないね
records.en_original: We may have a lot of ideas at this point, but I think we just don't have enough information.
records.en_auxiliary: We may have a lot of ideas at this point, but I think we just don't have enough information.
records.en: We're starting to imagine all kinds of possibilities,<CR>but we still don't have enough information.

records.jp: うん。結局、さっきの“クラック”が<CR>どうとかいうのも分からないし……
records.en_original: Yeah. In the end, we still don't even know what that Crack thing was.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. In the end, we still don't even know what that Crack thing was.
records.en: Yeah. We still don't know<CR>what that 'Crack' was either...

records.jp: 春日さんが突然現れたのも謎のままだし
records.en_original: Nor why Kasuga suddenly appeared.
records.en_auxiliary: Nor why Kasuga suddenly appeared.
records.en: Nor why Kasuga-san suddenly appeared.

records.jp: ユーコちゃんに聞けば、<CR>何か分かるのかもしれないけど……
records.en_original: We might learn something from asking Yuko, but...
records.en_auxiliary: We might learn something from asking Yuko, but...
records.en: Yuuko-chan might know something,<CR>but...

records.jp: あの感じだと、教えてくれそうにないね
records.en_original: It didn't seem like she wanted to tell us anything.
records.en_auxiliary: It didn't seem like she wanted to tell us anything.
records.en: It didn't seem like she wanted to tell us anything.

records.jp: またしばらくはココロトープ探しかなぁ
records.en_original: I guess we'll have to go back to the Heartscape.
records.en_auxiliary: I guess we'll have to go back to the Heartscape.
records.en: I guess we'll be searching Heartscapes for a while longer.

records.jp: わたしも協力します。<CR>何かできることがあるといいんですが……
records.en_original: I want to help too. If there's anything I can do...
records.en_auxiliary: I want to help too. If there's anything I can do...
records.en: I will help too.<CR>I hope there is something I can do...

records.jp: 人手は常に不足してるから、<CR>やれることはたくさんあるよ
records.en_original: We are already somewhat short-handed. I'm sure there will be plenty for you to help with.
records.en_auxiliary: We are already somewhat short-handed. I'm sure there will be plenty for you to help with.
records.en: We're always short-handed,<CR>so there will be plenty you can do.

records.jp: せっかく新しい仲間も増えたんだし、<CR>詩帆さんのアイデアも取り入れて何か作ってみようよ
records.en_original: Now that Shiho has joined us, we should get her ideas and build something new!
records.en_auxiliary: Now that Shiho has joined us, we should get her ideas and build something new!
records.en: Now that we have another companion,<CR>let's build something using Shiho-san's ideas.

records.jp: いいね～！　学校魔改造計画、再開だ！
records.en_original: Good idea! Extreme school makeover planning committee, back in session!
records.en_auxiliary: Good idea! Extreme school makeover planning committee, back in session!
records.en: Great! The School Super-Modification Plan is back!

records.jp: それまだ続いてたんだ……
records.en_original: Are you still going on about that?
records.en_auxiliary: Are you still going on about that?
records.en: Are you still going on about that?

records.jp: 料理人が来たんだから、<CR>こりゃ作業室じゃ役不足だよ！
records.en_original: We have a new cook now, so this work room isn't going to cut it anymore.
records.en_auxiliary: We have a new cook now, so this work room isn't going to cut it anymore.
records.en: Now that we have a cook,<CR>the workroom isn't up to the job!

records.jp: 厨房がないと。厨房が
records.en_original: Yeah, we need a real kitchen! A professional-grade kitchen!
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, we need a real kitchen! A professional-grade kitchen!
records.en: We need a kitchen. A kitchen.

records.jp: だから無理だって！
records.en_original: And how are we supposed to do that?
records.en_auxiliary: And how are we supposed to do that?
records.en: I told you, that is impossible!

records.jp: 楽しくなってきたね、詩帆ちゃん
records.en_original: Isn't this fun, Shiho?
records.en_auxiliary: Isn't this fun, Shiho?
records.en: It's getting exciting, isn't it, Shiho-chan?

records.jp: あ、あはは……
records.en_original: A-ahaha...
records.en_auxiliary: A-ahaha...
records.en: A-ahaha...
